auftrag: Read the case file. Then solve four puzzles.

saetze: It was in the Map Room.
Dr Cole saw it on Monday at six pm.
At seven pm the Map Room was locked.
On Tuesday morning the compass was gone.
Three people have a key: Agent Wren, Mr Hale and Dr Cole.
Sam, the cook, brings lunch to the Academy every day.
There was a note on the table.
It says: Take the nine forty-two train to Brighton.

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that tells you when the compass was seen last.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is in the first paragraph.

raetsel.frage: Who has a key to the Map Room?
optionen: Agent Wren, Mr Hale and Dr Cole
raetsel.hilfe2: Count the names in the third paragraph.

optionen: It is not there any more.
raetsel.hilfe1: On Tuesday morning the compass was gone.

raetsel.frage: Put the words in the right order. It is a sentence from the file.
raetsel.hilfe1: The sentence starts with the time.
raetsel.hilfe2: After "Dr Cole" comes the word that tells you what she did.
